jobs.title: Senior Director - Customer Analytics, Data & AI
jobs.description:
Location: Markham, Ontario

Job Description:

Position:
Senior Director, Customer Analytics, Data & AI

Type:
Full-Time | Hybrid

Location:
Markham, ON

Reports to
: VP, Loyalty & Customer Analytics

About Us

Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities.

What will you do?

The Senior Director, Customer Intelligence, Data & AI
is responsible for defining and executing Pet Valu's enterprise Customer Intelligence strategy, enabling the organization to maximize customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value through data-driven decision making.

This role provides strategic leadership across Customer Analytics, Business Intelligence, Customer Data Strategy, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Customer Measurement. The Senior Director serves as the organization's authority on customer behavior, customer value, and customer growth opportunities, translating complex data into actionable business strategies that support enterprise objectives.

Working closely with Marketing, Digital, Merchandising, Operations, Finance, Technology, and Executive Leadership, this role develops the analytical frameworks, predictive capabilities, AI roadmap, and customer intelligence infrastructure necessary to drive long-term growth and competitive differentiation.

The Senior Director also leads the development of an enterprise Customer Intelligence Centre of Excellence, ensuring insights, measurement, experimentation, and advanced analytics capabilities are embedded throughout the organization and consistently influence strategic and investment decisions.

This position manages a portfolio of customer data, analytics, AI, and technology investments intended to improve customer experience, strengthen loyalty, and generate measurable commercial value.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Customer Intelligence Strategy

Owns:

Enterprise Customer Intelligence Strategy
Customer Growth Insights Strategy
Customer Value Management Framework
Customer KPI Governance
Executive Customer Performance Reporting
Loyalty Analytics Centre of Excellence

Responsibilities:

Define and execute a multi-year Customer Intelligence strategy aligned to corporate growth objectives.
Act as the leader responsible for developing the organization's understanding of customer behavior, value, retention, and growth opportunities.
Establish enterprise customer measurement frameworks and key performance indicators used across business units.
Identify strategic opportunities to improve customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, retention, and profitability.
Partner with executive stakeholders to embed customer intelligence into strategic planning, resource allocation, and business decision-making processes.
Lead the development of an enterprise Customer Intelligence Centre of Excellence, driving best practices across analytics, measurement, experimentation, and insight generation.
Provide strategic recommendations and executive-level guidance regarding customer investment priorities and growth opportunities.

Customer Analytics & Advanced Insights

Owns:

Customer Analytics Strategy
Customer Segmentation Framework
Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) Methodology
Retention & Churn Analytics
Customer Health Measurement

Responsibilities:

Lead the development of advanced customer analytics capabilities that identify opportunities to improve customer value and business performance.
Oversee customer segmentation, lifetime value modeling, retention analysis, cohort analysis, and behavioral analytics.
Establish customer health and retention frameworks that proactively identify risks and opportunities across customer segments.
Partner with Loyalty, CRM, Digital, and Merchandising teams to improve customer engagement through actionable analytics and insight generation.
Translate customer data into executive recommendations that influence merchandising, promotional, loyalty, and customer experience strategies.

Data Science, AI & Predictive Intelligence

Owns:

Enterprise Loyalty AI Roadmap
Predictive Analytics Strategy
Advanced Personalization Analytics
Next-Generation Customer Intelligence Capabilities

Responsibilities:

Define and lead the organization's customer-focused AI and advanced analytics strategy.
Establish predictive modeling capabilities including churn prediction, customer lifetime value forecasting, propensity scoring, next-best-offer models, recommendation engines, and customer growth forecasting.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify practical applications that deliver measurable business value.
Partner with CRM, Loyalty, and Digital teams to operationalize predictive intelligence and support increasingly personalized customer experiences.
Develop governance frameworks that ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business objectives and executed responsibly.
Foster innovation through experimentation with emerging analytical techniques, machine learning solutions, and decision intelligence capabilities.

Customer Data Strategy & Governance

Owns:

Customer Data Strategy
Customer 360 Roadmap
Customer Data Governance
Identity Resolution Strategy
Customer Information Architecture

Responsibilities:

Define and oversee the customer data ecosystem required to support enterprise customer intelligence objectives.
Ensure customer data assets are accurate, accessible, scalable, secure, and actionable.
Oversee integration of customer, loyalty, retail, digital, eCommerce, app, and marketing datasets into a unified customer intelligence environment.
Partner with Technology, Digital, and external vendors to establish scalable customer data foundations and future-state capabilities.
Lead governance frameworks that support data quality, compliance, consistency, and effective enterprise data utilization.

Enterprise Measurement & Experimentation

Owns:

Measurement Strategy
Attribution Framework
Incrementality Measurement
Test-and-Learn Program
Customer Investment Evaluation Framework

Responsibilities:

Develop enterprise measurement frameworks that assess the commercial effectiveness of customer, marketing, loyalty, CRM, personalization, and digital initiatives.
Establish rigorous test-and-learn methodologies and experimentation standards.
Quantify the incremental impact of major customer investments, including loyalty programs, customer apps, personalization initiatives, and customer engagement platforms.
Lead the development of ROI frameworks used to assess customer and technology investments.
Ensure business decisions are supported by credible, transparent, and actionable evidence.

Strategic Investment & Business Performance Leadership

Owns:

Analytics Portfolio Management
Customer Growth Recommendations
Executive Decision Support

Responsibilities:

Develop business cases supporting customer, loyalty, digital, AI, and technology investments.
Provide executive leadership with actionable recommendations regarding customer growth opportunities, investment prioritization, and strategic trade-offs.
Influence enterprise planning through data-driven insights and predictive forecasts.
Partner with Finance and business leaders to ensure customer investments deliver measurable commercial outcomes.
Manage a portfolio of customer intelligence, analytics, and technology investments intended to drive long-term value creation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability Development

Owns:

Customer Intelligence Organization
Talent Strategy
Analytics Centre of Excellence
Capability Development Roadmap

Responsibilities:

Build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary team spanning customer analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence.
Develop future capability plans supporting organizational growth and evolving customer intelligence requirements.
Coach, mentor, and develop analytical and technical talent.
Foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Finance, Merchandising, Technology, Operations, and Digital teams.
Serve as a visible thought leader and advocate for customer-centric decision-making throughout the organization.

Loyalty & MarTech Platform Strategy

Own the vision, roadmap, and governance of the loyalty and MarTech ecosystem, including CRM, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), loyalty platforms, marketing automation, and customer engagement technologies.
Align platform capabilities with customer, loyalty, and business objectives.
Develop and execute the long-term Loyalty and MarTech strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise customer, digital, and marketing objectives.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend platform enhancements to improve customer engagement and marketing effectiveness.

Product Ownership & Delivery

Serve as Business Product Owner for key loyalty and MarTech platforms.
Define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and manage platform roadmaps.
Collaborate with IT, Product, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation and ongoing optimization of capabilities.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

Manage strategic relationships with MarTech vendors and service partners.
Negotiate contracts, oversee platform performance, and ensure service level expectations are met.
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Lead strategic partnerships with key vendors and external partners to ensure technology investments deliver expected business outcomes and return on investment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
Master's degree or MBA is considered an asset.
10+ years in Data Science, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, CRM Analytics, Loyalty Analytics, or Customer Insights.
7+ years leading analytics, BI, data science, or customer intelligence teams.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise customer intelligence, analytics, or data strategies that influence corporate growth objectives.
Proven success leading large-scale business transformation initiatives involving data platforms, cloud migrations, CDP, digital engagement, CRM, personalization, loyalty, or AI capabilities.
Experience serving as a strategic advisor to executive leadership teams, translating customer insights into business, marketing, digital, and commercial strategies.
Experience establishing and scaling customer analytics, data science, or AI capabilities within a complex retail, eCommerce, loyalty, or consumer-focused environment.
Extensive experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives across Marketing operations, Digital, Merchandising, Finance, IT, Operations, and Executive Leadership teams.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive organizational alignment without direct authority.
Experience managing competing priorities across multiple business units while balancing commercial, customer, operational, and technical requirements.
Track record of influencing enterprise investment decisions through analytics, business cases, and ROI measurement frameworks.
Demonstrated accountability for delivering measurable commercial outcomes, including customer retention, customer lifetime value growth, revenue growth, and return on investment.
Expert level knowledge of data integrations, data engineering, governance, API ecosystems, and data architecture.

Preferred:

Experience in retail, eCommerce, loyalty, or customer-centric industries

jobs.title: Director, Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
About Clutch

We’re on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars. Are you game?

Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that’s just the beginning. Named to The Globe and Mail’s list of Canada’s Top Growing Companies for six consecutive years and also awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team. Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, British Columbia, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including D1 Capital, Altos Ventures, BMO Capital Partners, Canaan, Real Ventures, and others. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

Finance at Clutch

We’re growing rapidly, with in‑house re‑conditioning centres, a captive lending platform and a national logistics network, we combine manufacturing‑grade operations with tech‑enabled consumer experience. We plan to be public company ready within 24–36 months and are building the finance foundation to get there. Strong systems keep our numbers accurate, our close on time, and financial information flowing clearly across the company, and they give leadership the confidence to make bold, well-timed decisions.

About The Role

Clutch is looking for a Director, Financial Reporting to step in as a critical leader on our finance team. Reporting directly to the Corporate Controller, you will architect the framework that turns thousands of data points per vehicle into clean, decision‑grade financial reporting. You will take charge of IFRS compliance, external audit readiness, and the design and implementation of a strong internal controls environment ahead of IPO readiness. You will lead a growing team that loves the craft of accounting as much as you do, taking ownership of the reporting cycle and technical accounting while partnering with Financial Systems leadership to drive ERP evolution.

What You’ll Do

Build and run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close; deliver accurate financial statements and supplementary financial information on tight deadlines.
Design and implement internal‑control, risk‑management, and policy frameworks to achieve NI 52‑109 readiness.
Lead external audits and statutory reporting; manage relationships with auditors and regulators.
Drive ERP/finance‑stack evolution in partnership with Financial Systems leadership
Build, mentor, and scale an accounting/reporting team; set clear performance standards and foster a culture of ownership and precision.
Build and leverage automations and AI to improve efficiency, reduce cost and risk.
Own cost and inventory accounting to support accurate financial statements.

What We’re Looking For

CPA with 8-10+ years’ progressive accounting leadership
Big 4 experience required; subsequent industry experience is considered an asset but is not mandatory
Command of IFRS plus advanced knowledge of revenue recognition, manufacturing, leasing, consolidation, and complex equity / debt transactions.
Proven experience establishing and strengthening internal control frameworks and implementing modern ERP and financial systems; experience with Oracle Fusion is considered an asset.
Experience building and leading teams, with a relentless attention to detail, ownership mentality, and a passion for building processes from the ground up.
Deep manufacturing or complex supply‑chain experience: cost accounting, inventory valuation, production labor, and overhead allocation are second nature.
Superb communicator able to translate accounting insights to non‑finance partners.

Why You'll Love It At Clutch

Be part of a disruptive, tech-driven company that is transforming the automotive industry — one of the largest and fastest-growing B2C startups in Canada.
A unique opportunity to work at the center of the company, helping shape how Clutch communicates, operates, and executes as we scale.
Freedom to innovate and ownership of your role — work on meaningful and challenging projects that have a direct impact on the business.
Collaborate with a talented and passionate team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Competitive pay and equity incentives.
Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
Opportunities for growth and development in a rapidly scaling company.

Employment Type

New, Permanent Full-Time

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $150,000 - $170,000 annually plus equity incentives.
Benefits: Comprehensive healthcare, dental, vision, prescriptions, life insurance, and dependent coverage; starting from day 1.
Pay decisions reflect skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities, and working conditions.

Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca
.

We use AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess applications. Final hiring decisions are made by our team.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Technology, Information and Internet
